display.purpose: Marketing hero headlines only. Instrument Serif.

display-xl.purpose: The single biggest mark on a landing page.

label.purpose: ALL CAPS MONO eyebrows, column headers, status chips.

wish.purpose: The one decorative flourish, italic serif pull-quote.

shadows.name: hard
shadows.purpose: Pressed/held states on buttons or tiles.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: The one soft blur. Overlays only (menus, toasts, modals). Never on chrome.

motion.name: dur-wish
motion.purpose: The permitted 'magical' slow fade, reserved for the .wish display element on first appearance.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Rare. Never bounce, overshoot, or spring.

breakpoints.name: max-content
breakpoints.purpose: Maximum content width. Long-form copy caps at ~72ch.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Sky-blue call-to-action. Sentence case. The default affordance for a primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #7aa7dc; color: #070d18; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: -0.01em; padding: 10px 20px; border: 1px solid #7aa7dc; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 80ms linear, color 80ms linear; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #a8c8ea; border-color: #a8c8ea; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7aa7dc; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Transparent background, moon-bone text. Secondary action that doesn't compete with a primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #f2f7fc; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: -0.01em; padding: 10px 20px; border: 1px solid #1f3a66; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 80ms linear, border-color 80ms linear; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #7aa7dc; border-color: #7aa7dc; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7aa7dc; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Chip (Accent)
components.description: ALL CAPS MONO status marker with sky border. Used for state labels in tables and headers.
components.css: .ds-chip-accent { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 8px; background: transparent; color: #7aa7dc; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; font-weight: 500; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; border: 1px solid #7aa7dc; border-radius: 4px; }

components.name: Panel Card
components.description: The workhorse container. Flat elevated surface, hairline border, no shadow at rest. Hover darkens the border to sky.
components.html:
Vessel 0x4a7f

Bound. Three wishes in smoke. Last seer: 0x2d91.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #142340; color: #f2f7fc; border: 1px solid #1f3a66; border-radius: 10px; padding: 24px; transition: border-color 140ms linear; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: #7aa7dc; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; font-weight: 500; font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: -0.01em; margin: 0 0 12px 0; color: #f2f7fc; } .ds-card-body { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; font-weight: 400; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.7; letter-spacing: -0.01em; margin: 0; color: #a4b0c2; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Mono-typed input with hairline border. Focus draws a 2px sky outline with 2px offset; visible, sharp, no glow.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; } .ds-field-label { font-weight: 500; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #a4b0c2; } .ds-input { background: #0c1628; color: #f2f7fc; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; font-weight: 400; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: -0.01em; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid #1f3a66; border-radius: 6px; outline: none; transition: border-color 80ms linear; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #7d8ba3; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7aa7dc; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Sigil — Node
components.description: Brand sigil for a participant vessel. ≥40px as a mark, 16/20/24 as an icon. Always currentColor.

narrative.overview: Jinn is protocol brutalism. The surface is a deep night-blue (#0c1628). Hierarchy is carried by hairline 1px borders, not shadows. The type system is two voices only — Instrument Serif for feeling, JetBrains Mono for doing — with no sans anywhere. Sky-blue ink threads structure; lamplight gold is reserved for a single point of emphasis on any surface. The contrast between evocative copy (summon, bind, vow, vessel, wish, smoke, seer, wane) and stark engineering-diagram UI is the brand. The system is headless by design: palette, sigils, and wordmark are expected to be forked by node operators and community contributors. The protocol invariants — the lexicon, the two-voice type system, the no-emoji / no-gradient / no-sans rules — are fixed. The narrative layer is not.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first. Canonical rendering is sky-blue ink on moon-bone, touched by lamplight.
Hairline borders are the primary hierarchy. Shadows are rare; blurs are banned for UI chrome.
Two type voices: serif for feeling, mono for doing. No sans.
Softened-brutalist radii (4 / 6 / 10). Never razor-square, never pillowy.
Linear motion. No bounce, overshoot, or spring.
Emoji never. The sigils and the words are the iconography.

rules.name: The Gold-as-Hint Rule
rules.body: Gold is a hint, not a fill. One gold element of emphasis per surface. If a design has gold in two places, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The No-Pure-Neutral Rule
rules.body: Never #000 or #fff. Every neutral carries a sky-blue tint.

rules.name: The One-Voice Rule
rules.body: A screen has one primary accent. Sky carries structure; gold carries emphasis. Never both loud at once.

rules.name: The Two-Voices Rule
rules.body: Serif for feeling, mono for doing. If a string is neither display headline nor mystical pull-quote, it is mono.

rules.name: The Labels-in-Caps, Actions-in-Sentence Rule
rules.body: ALL CAPS MONO is for status. Sentence case is for action.

rules.name: The Hairline-over-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is carried by more borders and less shadow than a typical system.

rules.name: The No-Float-on-Chrome Rule
rules.body: --shadow-float is for overlays only. Never on cards, buttons, inputs, or any resting-state container.

rules.name: The No-Glass Rule
rules.body: backdrop-filter: blur() is banned for UI chrome. If a designer feels they need glass, they need a border instead.

rules.name: The No-Emoji Rule
rules.body: Never. Not in product. Not in marketing. Not in docs. The sigils, the typography, and the words are the iconography.

rules.name: The Sigil-before-Lucide Rule
rules.body: For Jinn-native concepts (node, vow, smoke, wish, seer), use the brand sigil. Lucide at stroke 1.5 is a stand-in for generic UI affordances only.

dos: Do use JetBrains Mono for every label, value, body line, and code block.
Do use Instrument Serif only for display headlines, section heads, and the italic pull-quote (.wish).
Do use hairline 1px borders as the primary hierarchy. More borders, less shadow.
Do use gold as a single point of emphasis per surface.
Do use sentence case for titles, headlines, and button labels (Bind vessel).
Do use ALL CAPS MONO with letter-spacing 0.14em for labels, eyebrows, and status chips; never for anything read at length.
Do use softened-brutalist radii: chip 4px, default 6px, panel 10px.
Do tint every neutral toward #0c1628. No pure gray.
Do drop the vow-language whenever money, safety, or legal consent is on the line. Clarity beats mood.
Do document any change you make. The brand is headless; you're a co-author, not a user.
donts: Don't use emoji. Ever. Not in product. Not in marketing. Not in docs.
Don't use #000 or #fff. The darkest permitted neutral is #070d18; the lightest is #f2f7fc.
Don't use a sans font. The two-voices rule is the system.
Don't use gradients as decoration. The one exception is the top/bottom protection gradient over imagery.
Don't use backdrop-filter: blur() for UI chrome. If you want glass, use a border.
Don't use ease-out-back, ease-out-elastic, or any spring curve.
Don't use --shadow-float on cards, buttons, or inputs. Overlays only.
Don't nest cards inside cards. Ever.
Don't stack gold on gold. One gold element of emphasis per surface.
Don't use Material-style filled icons or multi-color iconography.
Don't invent new vow-language without marking it as a proposal. The lexicon is protocol, not narrative.
